core_obligations: The author converts vector Diophantine separation of the renormalization cocycle into uniform twisted Birkhoff bounds for random suspension flows, using weakly Lipschitz approximation and good-return words. The Erdős-Kahane dimension estimate is combined with symbolic estimates and a separate Rauzy combinatorial construction to obtain Hölder spectral measures in arbitrary genus.
